goals.0: Describing the weather: Es regnet, Es schneit, Es ist kalt
goals.3: Comparing the weather in your country and in Germany
dialog.1.de.2.n: In weather sentences es is required — „es ist kalt“
dialog.1.de.8.n: Grad stays the same in the plural: fünf Grad
grammar.0.title: Weather words
grammar.1.title: In weather sentences you always need „es“
grammar.1.text: In Bangla “it's raining” needs no subject. German does need one, as English does — the subject is es (an “empty subject”): „Es regnet.“, „Es schneit.“, „Es ist kalt.“ Temperature: „Es sind fünf Grad.“ or „Es hat fünf Grad.“ Below zero: „minus drei Grad“.
grammar.2.title: Jahreszeiten — the four seasons
grammar.2.note: All seasons are der-words, so „im“ (in dem): im Sommer = in summer.
quiz.6.why: Before a season use im: im Winter.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “It's cold today.”
